title: Tom DeLonge books on official and non-government programs

tellings.quote: you read the Tom Deong books, he sort of points to this idea of there essentially being, you know, official government programs and then non-government programs.

plain: Books by Tom DeLonge, a musician who writes about UFOs, point to the idea that there are official government UFO programs and also separate non-government ones. The analyst Matthew Pines brings this up on Michels' show, summarising the books without quoting them. If so, some of the secret work on these questions would sit outside government control.
